name: FFS_CATALOG_SCM_MAP
description: Facilitating the mapping of item field data from Supply Chain Management (SCM) to Oracle Field Service (OFS).

columns.name: CATALOG_SCM_MAP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the SCM catalog mapping.

columns.name: SCM_ITEM_FIELD_SRC_TYPE
columns.description: Identifies the type of SCM item field, categorizing each source field based on its structure within SCM for correct interpretation in OFS.

columns.name: SCM_ITEM_FIELD_SRC_LOCATOR
columns.description: Locator for SCM item fields, including the name or label of the field in the SCM system. Can be formatted in plain text or JSON.

columns.name: CATALOG_SCHEMA_LABEL
columns.description: Represents the destination label for SCM item fields in OFS, designating how SCM fields will be identified or labeled within OFS.

columns.name: CATALOG_SCHEMA_NAME
columns.description: Desired display name in Oracle Field Service (OFS).

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_CONFIG
columns.description: Additional not standardized JSON configuration of the mapping.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
